name: backrest
title: Backrest
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：前端在 x86 构建后内嵌；自带 restic 0.19.1。

缺失功能：首次需在 UI 建账号/仓库；默认无认证。

额外依赖：持久化 /data、/config、/cache；备份源目录需额外挂载。

镜像说明：v1.14.1 + restic 0.19.1；`/data`、`/config`、`/cache`；9898；UID 1108；首次 UI 建账号/仓库；默认无认证
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: Frontend is built on x86 and embedded; bundles restic 0.19.1.

Missing features: Create the account/repository in the UI first; no auth by default.

Extra dependencies: Persist /data, /config and /cache; mount the backup source directories separately.

Image notes: v1.14.1 + restic 0.19.1；`/data`、`/config`、`/cache`；9898；UID 1108；首次 UI 建账号/仓库；默认无认证

manual: 首次在 Web UI 创建账号与仓库
notes: 未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
